abilities.name: Pass It On
abilities.description: Once per encounter, as your Basic Action, choose another allied Tamer. Give them Hope from your own pool, up to their maximum Hope. You cannot give away more Hope than you currently have, and this can never take you below 0.

abilities.name: Boundless Hope
abilities.description: Your maximum Hope Pool permanently increases by 25.

abilities.name: Never Empty-Handed
abilities.description: Pass It On is no longer limited to once per encounter. You may use it as your Basic Action as often as you have a Basic Action to spend.

abilities.name: Perfect Timing
abilities.description: You may use your Basic Action immediately before an ally's turn begins to activate Pass It On. The Hope is provided before the start of their turn, allowing it to be used to pay their Digimon's maintenance cost and prevent it from de-digivolving.

abilities.name: Never Truly Empty
abilities.description: Once per encounter, if you would hit 0 Hope for any reason, you may instead restore half your Hope. If you hit 0 Hope specifically from the start of turn deduction, you still dedigivolve as normal.

abilities.name: Hope Spreads
abilities.description: Whenever you use Pass It On, you may choose a second, different Tamer to also receive that same amount of Hope, at no additional cost to you.
